body.name: Contraction--Möbius classification handle
body.construction: Start from contraction consistency \(g(z)=r\) and \(r\subseteq w\subseteq z\Rightarrow g(w)=r\); condition on the full-offer choice \(g(U)\); reduce \(\sigma_t(g)=0\) first at triples, then pairs, then singletons; and close each branch by an explicit strict ranking. The target object is a non-enumerative proof that the full-offer-pair branch has exactly four maps with the remaining factor unresponsive and two with it responsive.
